runtime: Windows 11 Enterprise lab workstation (10.0.26200), Entra-joined and Intune-managed; Intune Management Extension 1.106.151.0; Windows PowerShell 5.1 64-bit, user context.
procedure: Assigned through Intune Remediations (hourly) to a group containing only the device owner. After the script update the device kept running the cached previous version; restarting the IntuneManagementExtension service made it fetch the new version. Read deviceRunStates via Microsoft Graph beta with a read-only app.
expected: Detection reports the module missing on first run, then reports installed versions and exits 0 after remediation.
observed: Pre-detection: "Microsoft.WinGet.Client module not installed." Post-detection: "Git.Git=2.55.0.5; Anthropic.ClaudeCode=2.1.302; OpenAI.Codex=0.161.0", detectionState after remediation compliant.
limitations: The packages were already installed on the device, so the install path (Install-WinGetPackage) and the not-applicable upgrade path were not exercised; the run upgraded or confirmed existing installs.
Microsoft.WinGet.Client version installed from PSGallery was not recorded.
